questions.stem: Which is a key difference between the transport systems of animals and plants?

options.text: Plants have a circulatory system with a pump, while animals rely on diffusion
Plants have red blood cells to transport oxygen, while animals do not
Animals transport sugars in their blood vessels, while plants transport sugars in their xylem
Animals have a pump (the heart) to circulate blood, while plants rely on transpiration and pressure differences

questions.explanation: Animals have a heart that pumps blood around the body in a circulatory system. Plants do not have a pump; instead, water movement in xylem is driven by transpiration pull, and sugar movement in phloem is driven by pressure differences between sources and sinks.
